categories.main_business_segments: Floor & Decor operates as a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories, with two operating segments: Retail (the primary reportable segment, including warehouse-format stores and e-commerce) and Spartan (commercial surfaces, not separately reportable). The company sells laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, natural stone flooring, installation materials, decorative accessories, and adjacent categories. As of December 26, 2024, it operated 251 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 38 states, as well as a commercial surfaces business through its Spartan subsidiary.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a direct sourcing model, purchasing products directly from over 240 manufacturers and quarries in 26 countries, bypassing intermediaries to reduce costs and improve speed to market. Its supply chain is supported by four regional distribution centers and advanced inventory management systems with data-driven forecasting. Floor & Decor invests in technology across supply chain, merchandising, e-commerce, and store operations, and regularly upgrades its core financial and merchandising systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Floor & Decor serves a diverse customer base, including professional installers and commercial businesses ('Pro'), as well as homeowners (both do-it-yourself and buy-it-yourself customers). The company appeals to both residential and commercial markets, with approximately 51% of retail sales in 2024 from homeowners and 49% from Pros. Its commercial surfaces business, including the Spartan subsidiary, targets commercial clients such as builders and contractors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in 38 U.S. states, with a strong presence in states like California, Florida, and Texas (each with 27-33 stores), and a nationwide distribution network. All stores and distribution centers are located in the United States, with a sourcing office in Shanghai, China. Floor & Decor plans continued expansion across new and existing U.S. markets, aiming for at least 500 warehouse-format stores long-term.
categories.supply_chain_position: Floor & Decor operates downstream in the supply chain as a specialty retailer, but differentiates itself by direct sourcing from manufacturers and quarries, effectively integrating upstream procurement. It manages its own distribution centers and logistics, providing immediate product availability and job-lot quantities to customers, and bypasses traditional wholesalers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the store footprint, increasing comparable store sales, enhancing the connected customer experience (integrating online and in-store), investing in Pro and design services, growing the commercial surfaces business, and improving operating margins through scale and efficiency. The company emphasizes innovation in product assortment, proprietary brands, and technology investments in supply chain, e-commerce, and customer engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Floor & Decor generates revenue primarily through the sale of hard surface flooring, installation materials, decorative accessories, and adjacent home improvement products via its warehouse-format stores, design studios, e-commerce platform, and commercial sales. Revenue is recognized at the point of sale or upon delivery, with additional income from services such as design consulting and Pro loyalty programs, but no installation services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly fragmented market against big-box home improvement centers (e.g., Home Depot, Lowe’s), national and regional specialty flooring retailers, independent flooring retailers, and distributors. Floor & Decor positions itself as a one-stop destination with the broadest in-stock assortment, everyday low prices, and a differentiated customer experience, aiming to gain market share from less specialized or less agile competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2024, Floor & Decor reported net sales of $4.46 billion, net income of $205.9 million, and Adjusted EBITDA of $512.5 million. The company opened 30 new warehouse-format stores in 2024, ending the year with 251 stores. While comparable store sales declined 7.1% in both 2023 and 2024 due to macroeconomic headwinds, overall net sales grew 0.9% year-over-year, driven by new store openings and commercial sales. The company maintains a strong liquidity position and continues to invest in growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Floor & Decor emphasizes a unique value proposition based on a comprehensive, trend-forward in-stock assortment (averaging 4,400 SKUs per store), everyday low prices enabled by direct sourcing, immediate product availability in job-lot quantities, and a one-stop shopping experience for entire flooring projects. The company offers free in-store design services, a robust online platform, and specialized Pro services, creating customer loyalty and differentiating itself from both big-box and specialty competitors.
